# Klarframe Radio

> Klarframe Radio (radio.klarframe.com) produces broadcast-ready radio and podcast pieces with AI voices. You name a topic, paste your own text or add web pages; the platform researches, writes an original script, has it spoken by one, two or three native-sounding AI voices, checks every spoken line and delivers the finished audio — usually within minutes. Built by Klarframe in Palma (Mallorca, Spain). Languages: German, English and Spanish.

## What it is

- A web platform (software as a service) that turns a topic, a text or a set of web pages into a finished radio or podcast piece: research, script, voices, editing and delivery in one flow.
- Every figure in a piece is backed by a source; sources are listed in the show notes.
- Every piece openly says that AI voices are speaking (spoken AI notice plus metadata in the audio file, as required by the EU AI Act, Art. 50).

## Who it is for

- Radio stations: hourly local news, weather, feature strands, links between songs, versions in other languages.
- Businesses: in-store radio, hotel radio, company podcasts and announcements.
- Podcasters and newsrooms that need regular, well-sourced audio without a studio.

## How it works

- Three ways to start: (1) your own text blocks, (2) web pages you name, (3) AI research on a topic you give.
- One, two or three speakers: a single presenter, a two-voice conversation, or a three-voice panel (e.g. host, pro, contra).
- Native scripts in German, English and Spanish — each language gets its own script with natural expressions and forms of address, not a translation.
- Emotions and tone: adjustable humour, laughter, warmth, energy, pace and language level; voices laugh when something is funny and slow down when it gets serious.
- Evidence: every number is linked to its source; facts are taken from sources, wording never is.
- Quality check: every spoken line is transcribed again and compared with the script; lines that do not match are re-recorded automatically.
- Optional script approval: stop after the script, read and edit it, then approve it for recording (recommended for news).
- AI label: a spoken AI notice in every piece plus machine-readable metadata.

## Formats

News (45 s–10 min, 1 voice), Weather (30 s–2 min), Feature (1–15 min, 1–2 voices), Conversation (2–60 min, 2 voices), Magazine (5–60 min, 1–3 voices), Satire (1–5 min, 1–3 voices), Interview (3–15 min, 2–3 voices), Links (10–60 s), Announcement (10–60 s), What's on (1–3 min, 1–2 voices), Daily briefing (3–8 min), Panel talk (5–60 min, 3 voices).

## Delivery

Download (MP3 or WAV), podcast feed (RSS), stream for in-store and hotel radio, webhook, SFTP / S3, playout-system connectors for radio stations (e.g. mAirList, Zetta, WideOrbit, DAVID) and an API.

## Pricing

Net prices plus VAT. The binding price is shown before each order.

- Try it free: 10 trial minutes after sign-up, no payment details needed. Trial pieces can be listened to in the portal; download and delivery after ordering.
- Length: from a 20-second announcement up to {max_min}-minute programmes per piece. Long pieces are planned as segments, each researched separately, with chapter markers — ideal for radio specials and weekly magazines.
- Single piece: from {einzel} for a piece up to {einzel_min} minutes. No subscription, pay as you go. One or two voices cost the same.
- Subscriptions: from {abo} per month for {abo_min} minutes, for regular programmes on a schedule. Cancellable monthly.
- Billing by the second of finished audio; the price you ordered is the upper limit. If your balance runs out, pieces pause instead of being charged extra.

## Deutsch — Kurzfassung

Klarframe Radio erstellt sendefertige Radio- und Podcast-Beiträge mit KI-Stimmen: Thema nennen, eigenen Text einfügen oder Webseiten angeben – die Plattform recherchiert, schreibt ein eigenes Drehbuch, lässt es von ein bis drei muttersprachlichen KI-Stimmen (Deutsch, Englisch, Spanisch) sprechen und hört jede Zeile nach. Jede Zahl ist mit einer Quelle belegt, jeder Beitrag nennt sich selbst als KI-Beitrag. Für Radiosender und Firmen (Ladenfunk, Hotelradio, Podcasts). {probe_min} Minuten kostenlos testen; Einzelbeitrag ab {einzel}, Abo ab {abo} im Monat. Kontakt: info@klarframe.com.

## Español — Resumen

Klarframe Radio produce piezas de radio y pódcast listas para emitir con voces de IA: indicas un tema, pegas tu propio texto o añades páginas web, y la plataforma investiga, escribe un guion propio, lo hace leer por una, dos o tres voces de IA nativas (alemán, inglés, español) y comprueba cada línea. Cada cifra tiene su fuente y cada pieza se identifica como contenido de IA. Para emisoras y empresas (radio para tiendas y hoteles, pódcast). {probe_min} minutos de prueba gratis; pieza suelta desde {einzel}, suscripción desde {abo} al mes. Contacto: info@klarframe.com.
